description: This file defines the structures, function prototypes, and documentation for a Lua binding of a 3D vector type. It includes the vector data structure, functions to create and manipulate vectors, and binding functions for Lua integration.

classes.name: lu5_vector
classes.description: A structure representing a 3D vector with double-precision floating point components x, y, and z.

methods.name: createVector
methods.description: Creates a new vector instance from given components x, y, z.

methods.name: lu5_vector_print
methods.description: Prints the vector to the Lua output.

methods.name: lu5_vector_dist
methods.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance between two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_dot
methods.description: Computes the dot product of two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_add
methods.description: Returns the sum of two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_sub
methods.description: Returns the difference of two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_mult
methods.description: Returns the component-wise product of two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_div
methods.description: Returns the component-wise division of two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_idiv
methods.description: Returns the component-wise integer division of two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_copy
methods.description: Returns a copy of the vector.

methods.name: lu5_bind_vector
methods.description: Binds the vector functions and methods to a Lua state.
